entries.title: Clear updates, separate choices
changes: Launcher updates show a tray notification and a clear in-app alert. Checks continue every 15 minutes while open or minimized.
Addon updates show an in-app alert only. They always need separate version approval.
Click an addon row for details. Original screenshots flank the website, with click-to-enlarge previews.

entries.title: Your approval, every addon update
changes: Background checks only notify. Addons are never installed by a launcher update or startup.
Install, update and reinstall ask for your approval and show the exact addon version.
Click anywhere on an addon row to open its details; the arrow button is removed.
Existing launchers can discover Raid Tool 1.0.4 independently of the launcher updater.
Original launcher and in-game screenshots flank the download page. Click either image to enlarge.

entries.title: A matching home for your compass
changes: DarkWhispers Raid Tool 1.0.4 matches the launcher with a restrained dark gothic palette.
A clean light-blue compass and softer Carlito font; existing layouts and functions stay intact.
Open addon settings with /dwrt. The old /acomp command is removed.
Update the addon directly in your current launcher; a launcher update is optional.

entries.title: Sharper identity, simpler controls
changes: Cinzel Bold branding with a slow crimson glow across the website and launcher.
A compact Auto-update switch sits above the addon list. The extra Windows frame is removed.
Clear launcher download and installation details, with source code, scans and reports linked on GitHub.
DarkWhispers Raid Tool 1.0.3 has its own gothic tools logo. The vampire remains the website and launcher identity.

entries.title: Darkness, refined
changes: A shared hooded vampire logo, bold gothic wordmark and animated crimson theme across the launcher and website.
Four clear website choices: launcher, Chrome installation, direct addon ZIP and organized GitHub downloads.
Compact addon rows retain independent update checks, latest versions, release dates and notes.

entries.title: Clearer addon updates
changes: Compact dark addon rows show installed and latest versions, update dates and release notes.
Check and install addon updates directly from each row. Addon updates are independent of launcher updates.
Cached catalogs no longer claim Up to date. Returning to the launcher refreshes the list when needed.

entries.title: Your raid marker default
changes: DarkWhispers Raid Tool 1.0.2 ships Skull at north, then Triangle, Moon, Square, Cross, Star, Circle and Diamond clockwise.
Existing saved layouts and calibrations stay intact. New custom layouts still start empty.

entries.title: A new home for your raid tools
changes: Custom launcher window, frost visuals and clearer addon selection.
Minimize to tray; optional automatic addon updates, off by default.
No retained addon backups. Reinstall or update to the latest release.
Readable scan reports, orange GitHub downloads and this changelog.

entries.title: A smoother launcher
changes: Cleaner controls, compact dialogs and paused animations while inactive.

entries.title: Signed launcher updates
changes: Version-bound launcher updates and safer interrupted-install recovery.
